findings.title: Spec mock-adjustment constraint met by platform pin
findings.problem: spec.md:58 states that, because the win32 refresh branch executes for real on the test-windows job, the order-sensitive readFile mocks in plugin-installer.test.ts:79-103 must be adjusted. Those mocks are unchanged; the change instead pins process.platform to 'linux' in beforeEach (line 38, as plan.md step 5 prescribes), so this suite never enters the win32 refresh branch on any OS and the already_exists case at lines 80-104 no longer exercises refresh under the mocked filesystem.
findings.impact: No runtime behaviour is missing, and the win32 already_exists refresh path is exercised against a real filesystem in claude.plugin-installer.hooks.test.ts (lines 140-206), so practical coverage loss is small. What stays open is an unaccepted deviation from a 'must' in the approved spec: the requirement remains partial, and the mocked suite silently stops describing Windows, until someone accepts or reverses the pin.
findings.recommendation: Human decision required, not inferable from the spec: (a) accept the platform pin as the way the spec.md:58 constraint is met and record that decision with its rationale — no source edit needed; or (b) remove the pin from beforeEach and extend the access/readFile mock sequences at lines 79-103 (and 146-177) so they describe the win32 refresh reads on the test-windows job.
